# AI Zhangle Agent Design System

This repository is an Agent-readable design-system source for AI Zhangle / New Zhangle mobile screens.

Start with:

- `SKILL.md`
- `manifest.json`
- `DESIGN.md`
- `authoring/components/index.yaml`
- `docs/references/component-brief-workflow.md`
- `canon/foundations/tokens/color.tokens.json`
- `schemas/component.schema.json`
- `schemas/component-brief.schema.yaml`
- `canon/checklists/visual-review.yaml`

Human reference material is under `docs/references/`.

Generated outputs are under `generated/` and are not source of truth.

For component work, treat `authoring/components/*.brief.yaml` as the human-authored input and expand it into `canon/components/`, `canon/checklists/`, `bindings/figma/components.yaml`, and `docs/generated/components/index.md`.

For visual generation or aesthetic review, start with `DESIGN.md`. Akun foundation files own base values; Dengpeng visual-language files supplement atmosphere, hierarchy, density, and design tasting.
